_comment: The staff menu, as buildNav in nala-shared.js draws it on every page:
the top links in order, then the collapsible submenus in order, then
Logout. Four suites used to hold their own copy of the menu order,
which is why adding a page meant editing them all. They read this
table now - the phone_cases.json pattern. Change the menu in NAV and
here, and whichever side was missed fails by name.
